# omni_user_group (Data Source)

Looks up an Omni user group by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The group name. One of `id` or `display_name` is required.
- `id` (String) The group's unique ID. One of `id` or `display_name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `member_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the users in the group.
